reveal.en: Beneath a forest floor, fungi connect the roots of different trees, creating underground networks where nutrients and signals can move.
reveal.zh: 森林地表之下，真菌连接不同树木的根系，形成地下网络，让养分和信息能够在其中传递。

meaning.en: A forest is not simply a collection of trees. Much of its intelligence exists in invisible relationships.
meaning.zh: 森林并不是孤立树木的集合，许多生命智慧存在于看不见的连接之中。
